steps.say: Plan: add a lid on top of the crate.

params.label: add lid
params.code:
mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new('Crate_Lid')
bm = bmesh.new()
bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
bm.to_mesh(mesh)
bm.free()
lid = bpy.data.objects.new('Crate_Lid', mesh)
lid.scale = (0.54, 0.54, 0.04)
lid.location = (0, 0, 0.52)
bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(lid)
print('lid', lid.name)

else.say: No sketch to check against: rendering from my own camera.

steps.say: Done: the crate has a lid.
